name: api_request
description: Send a raw request to the panel REST API with the configured token. Use it only for endpoints no dedicated tool covers. All methods are allowed.

query.description: Query parameters; objects and arrays are sent as JSON strings

name: api_tokens_create
description: Create a new API token. This endpoint is forbidden to use via "API-key". It can only be used with an admin JWT-token.

expiresInDays.description: Expiration days of the API token

name: api_tokens_delete
description: Delete API token. This endpoint is forbidden to use via "API-key". It can be used only with an admin JWT-token.

name: api_tokens_list
description: Get all API tokens. This endpoint is forbidden to use via "API-key". It can only be used with admin JWT-token.

name: api_tokens_scopes
description: Get available API token scopes. Returns the catalog of scopes that can be granted to an API token, grouped by resource. Forbidden via "API-key", admin JWT only.

name: auth_status
description: Get the status of the authentication

description: Get Node Users Usage by Node UUID

topNodesLimit.description: Limit of top nodes to return

name: bandwidth_nodes_usage_threshold
description: Get users exceeding a traffic threshold on the given nodes for a period. Returns users whose total usage over the period on the given nodes is >= minTotalBytes. Underlying usage data is flushed to the database roughly every 2 minutes.

minTotalBytes.description: Only include users whose total usage over the period is >= this (bytes)

name: bandwidth_nodes_users
description: Get Nodes Users Usage by Nodes UUIDs

name: bandwidth_squad_usage
description: Get internal squad users traffic usage for a period. Returns users whose total usage over the period on the given nodes is >= minTotalBytes, scoped to the nodes reachable via the internal squad inbounds. Underlying usage data is flushed to the database roughly every 2 minutes.

minTotalBytes.description: Only include users whose total usage over the period is >= this (bytes)

limit.description: Number of users to return, no more than 1000

cursor.description: Pass the nextCursor from the previous response. Omit on the first request.

name: bandwidth_squad_user_usage
description: Get a single user daily traffic usage on the internal squad nodes for a period. Returns users whose total usage over the period on the given nodes is >= minTotalBytes, scoped to the nodes reachable via the Internal Squad inbounds. Every day in the range is present (zero-filled). Underlying usage data is flushed to the database roughly every 2 minutes.

start.description: Start index (offset) of the billing history records to return, default is 0

size.description: Number of billing records to return, no more than 500

name: system_stats_digest
description: Get Stats Digest. Aggregated statistics for a datetime range [start, end): created and expired users, total traffic, traffic spent by users created within the range and new HWID devices. Per-user traffic history is stored with daily granularity (UTC), so the "traffic by new users" metric snaps to whole days at the range edges.

start.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 datetime with timezone (e.g. 2026-07-15T00:00:00Z). Inclusive.

end.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 datetime with timezone (e.g. 2026-07-16T00:00:00Z). Exclusive.

name: users_create
description: Create a user. Credentials (vlessUuid/ssPassword/trojanPassword/shortUuid) are generated by the panel unless given — pass them explicitly for service users.

username.description: Unique username for the user. Required. Must be 3-36 characters long and contain only letters, numbers, underscores and dashes.

status.description: Optional. User account status. Defaults to ACTIVE.

shortUuid.description: Optional. Short UUID identifier for the user.

trojanPassword.description: Optional. Password for Trojan protocol. Must be 8-32 characters.

vlessUuid.description: Optional. UUID for VLESS protocol. Must be a valid UUID format.

ssPassword.description: Optional. Password for Shadowsocks protocol. Must be 8-32 characters.

trafficLimitBytes.description: Optional. Traffic limit in bytes. Set to 0 for unlimited traffic.

lastTrafficResetAt.description: Optional. Date of last traffic reset. Format: 2025-01-17T15:38:45.065Z

description.description: Optional. Additional notes or description for the user account.

tag.description: Optional. User tag for categorization. Max 16 characters, uppercase letters, numbers and underscores only.

telegramId.description: Optional. Telegram user ID for notifications. Must be an integer.

email.description: Optional. User email address. Must be a valid email format.

hwidDeviceLimit.description: Optional. Maximum number of hardware devices allowed. Must be a positive integer.

activeInternalSquads.description: Optional. Array of UUIDs representing enabled internal squads.

name: users_extend_expiration
description: Extend user expiration date. If user status is EXPIRED, the new expiration date is calculated from the current date and the user becomes ACTIVE. If user status is ACTIVE, the given number of days is added to the existing expiration date. DISABLED and LIMITED users will be extended, but their status will not change.

days.description: The number of days to extend the expiration date.

name: users_list
description: List users with offset pagination and optional TanStack-style filters. To find users by telegramId, email, tag, status etc. pass filters, e.g. [{"id":"telegramId","value":123456789}]. Users are identified by numeric id.

start.description: Start index (offset) of the results to return, default is 0

size.description: Number of results to return, no more than 1000

name: users_resolve
description: Resolve a user by EXACTLY ONE of: id, shortUuid, username

name: users_revoke_subscription
description: Revoke user subscription: rotates the subscription link (and credentials unless told otherwise)

revokeOnlyPasswords.description: Optional. If true, only passwords will be revoked, without changing the short UUID (Subscription URL).

shortUuid.description: Optional. If not provided, a new short UUID will be generated by Remnawave. Please note that it is strongly recommended to allow Remnawave to generate the short UUID.

name: users_stream
description: Get all users using cursor-based (keyset) pagination with filtering options

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination — pass the nextCursor from the previous response. Omit on the first request.

size.description: Number of results to return, no more than 1000

trafficLimitStrategy.description: Traffic limit strategy to filter users by

telegramId.description: Telegram ID to filter users by

externalSquadUuid.description: External squad UUID to filter users by
